verdict.rationale: Stripe Terminal integrations can react automatically to events via webhooks and offline payments auto-forward when connectivity resumes, and Stripe's broader platform offers agent-first tools (MCP server, agents.md) that could be used to build autonomous workflows. However, none of this evidence describes a dedicated 'set up an automation that runs autonomously in the background' capability specific to Terminal itself (e.g., scheduled jobs, agent-driven POS automation). Missing for 10: Terminal-specific automation/orchestration features, documented autonomous agent workflows tied to in-person payment flows, and independent confirmation of such automations working end-to-end.
